entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling because I think I need to return something. I'm not sure. The whole process is very confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. I've pulled up your account. Are you calling about the VeloFit helmet you purchased a couple of months ago?
Oh, yes, the helmet. That's the one. The box is still unopened, I haven't even looked at it since it arrived.
Okay, I see. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Preference, I guess? The color just wasn't what I expected from the website picture. I was thinking about safety and visibility on the road, and I just don't feel right about this one. I got so overwhelmed by it all I just put it aside. Can't you just help me?

I understand completely, and I'm happy to help. Let me just confirm the return policy for you. I can see here that you received the item 70 days ago. For a standard item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.
Oh, really? 90 days? I was so worried I had missed the deadline. So you can take it back?

Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened and you're well within the return window, I can process this for you right now. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label. You just need to print it out and attach it to the original shipping box.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. You've made this very easy.
You're very welcome! Once we receive the helmet, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
